item: Clock in, turn off alarm, turn on lights

item: Turn on: bread oven, proofer, grill, drop-ins, steam table

Fill out Bread Tracking & Production Report as you go
Set up hot sub area & front line (skip onions, lettuce, tomatoes)

Sort, date, and slice tomatoes (set tomatoes out by 10 am)
Complete set up in frontline and backline (set up: knives, towels, cutting boards and sani buckets)
Fill out Line-Up Sheet (bread, sales, focus)
Check all checklists from previous day
